title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A web application designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Editor
features.description: An integrated code editor with support for multiple programming languages and real-time syntax highlighting.

features.name: Submission System
features.description: A system to allow users to submit their solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A leaderboard to track user performance and encourage competition among participants.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Personalized user profiles to track progress, achievements, and submitted solutions.

constraints: Should provide real-time feedback on submissions
Needs to handle a large number of concurrent users
target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for coding competitions
data_requirements: Requires storage for user profiles, problem data, submission history, and leaderboard information
